idea_title: Causal tracing of in-context forgetting across scale
idea_description: Study how and where transformers overwrite earlier in-context facts as context grows, using causal interventions to localize the responsible heads across model scales.
rationale: Mechanistic account of in-context forgetting across scale is not an established published result.

idea_description: Order training examples by curvature/geometry signals of the loss landscape rather than difficulty heuristics, testing whether geometry-aware curricula speed convergence.
rationale: Loss-geometry-driven curricula are speculative and not broadly published.

rationale: Energy-measured (not FLOP-proxy) MoE routing is largely open.

idea_description: Investigate whether delayed-generalization (grokking) occurs during cross-modal alignment training and what governs its onset.
rationale: Cross-modal grokking is an open empirical question.

idea_title: Delayed generalization (grokking) during RLHF / preference optimization
idea_description: Investigate whether 'grokking' — generalization emerging long after the training objective has plateaued — occurs during RLHF or direct preference optimization, i.e. a phase where alignment/preference generalization appears well after the reward or DPO loss stops improving, and what governs its onset.
rationale: Searched grokking + RLHF/DPO/preference optimization. Grokking is studied in supervised/algorithmic and (recently) low-precision settings, but no paper on delayed-generalization dynamics specifically in RLHF/preference optimization was found. Closest: grokking in supervised training; slingshot in low-precision — neither addresses the preference-optimization setting. NOTE: same 'grokking-in-a-new-setting' flavor as p_crossmodal_grokking, so treat the two as correlated, not independent signal.
